info.title: TaskVilla REST API
info.description:
Proposed server contract for app.adc.taskvilla. Unified OTP and logout: Only OTP request/verify for first and returning users; no passwords or separate login/registration. OTP proves mailbox access, not legal identity. Logout-all includes current session; immediate server-side active-session checks required. Offline SQLite is not remotely wiped.

Permission rules: Owner controls list metadata, deletion, invitation and removal. Accepted editor manages tasks/reorder and may leave. Pending recipient reads invitation metadata only and accepts/ignores; no home entry or task content before acceptance. Actor/owner IDs derived server-side; every export, attachment and sync page reauthorizes.

Demographics versus request context: Audit all server calls: UTC time, derived user/session/IP, route/action, result, bounded app/device metadata. Phone/age/gender/country/city are optional self-reported with consent, not scraped or verified by email OTP. No IMEI/SIM/contacts collection. IP may be VPN/NAT; no exact location/person inference. Other members never see these fields.

Offline actions: Optional consented client events queue offline; untrusted time/action. Upload IP belongs to reconnect/upload, not the historical action. API middleware audits network actions independently. No private task/profile text in events.

Proposed security defaults: OTP6digits/5min/5attempts/resend60s. Access15min; refresh sliding30d, absolute90d, rotated and digested. Revocations transactional with sign-in/refresh. HTTPS in production, secure token storage, generic failures, per-IP/email/device rate limits, no raw tokens/OTP/SMTP/body/query/profile values in logs. Request audit90d, optional client events30d; configure/disclose retention, restrict audit access and encrypt sensitive profile fields.

Offline sync and migration: UUID cloud IDs; current local string-list/integer-task IDs migrated explicitly through backup import mapping. Retry writes through CRUD+Idempotency-Key; If-Match stale412 means reconcile. Snapshot/delta cursors bind user/auth generation; revocation/expiry410 requires cache reset. Keep private local-only records separate. Shared cached data purged on next contact. Sharing end-to-end test remains deferred until requested.

Backup compatibility: Existing format1 JSON and typed XML, schema3, filenames-only attachments. Server exports adapt UUIDs to local-compatible IDs. Import validates whole graph, creates new private copies, never restores membership/consent/auth authority. No overwriting existing data. Hidden subtasks preserved. XML external entities disabled.

Generation and scope: OpenAPI3.1.0 for compatible Python/PHP/Node generators: handlers/models/client SDK scaffolds. OTP delivery, ACLs, data storage, transactional revocation/sync, SMTP worker and actual business behavior still need code. Draft v1.0.0, current app remains offline v0.22.0, no deployed server. Owner-only list metadata, editor role,14d invitations and listed limits are proposed defaults. No public admin/scheduler/demographic bulk API.

servers.description: Future local development; not running. Use HTTPS in production.

post.description: Unified first/returning user flow. Cryptographic 6-digit code, TTL 300s, keyed digest at rest, max 5 attempts, resend >=60s via same endpoint invalidates prior challenge. Per-IP/email/device send limits. Same generic 202 shape/timing for existing/new addresses and suppressed delivery; never return OTP/account existence. Create user only after verification. SMTP credentials on server only.

post.summary: Verify OTP; find or create account
post.description: Atomically consume challenge and find/create one user with unique normalized-email key, issue session. Bind challenge to originating installation/email/purpose. Wrong/expired/exhausted OTP ->400 OTP_INVALID, no account enumeration. Same-key identical retry may replay encrypted response for 60s to original active session; different key cannot reuse OTP. Email domain lowercased; local-part canonicalization policy must be consistent, never provider-specific dot/plus rewriting. No separate login or registration route.

Refresh token is credential; no access token required. Rotate transactionally; detected reuse revokes session family except bounded identical-idempotency retry. Sliding refresh expiry 30d, absolute session lifetime 90d. Serialize with logout-all so revoked sessions cannot be recreated. Invalid/revoked token ->401.
Revoke current session/access/refresh immediately; clear secure client tokens. Offline SQLite is not remotely erased.

404.description: Not found or concealed inaccessible resource

post.description: Atomically revoke every session including current and increment user session epoch. All old access/refresh credentials fail immediately: server checks active session on every request. Serialize against verify/refresh; sign-in after revocation is permitted. Other devices discover 401 on reconnect. Does not erase offline SQLite.

DeviceContext.description: Client-reported and untrusted; app-scoped random installation UUID, not IMEI/SIM/hardware identity. No automatic phone extraction.

Demographics.description: Optional self-report with consent; not inferred from IP. Prefer age band over birth date; no compulsory demographic fields.

User.description: Own private profile only. Phone is optional self-reported and unverified; email OTP verifies mailbox only. Demographics/phone never exposed to list members.

ProfilePatch.description: Stored or accompanying affirmative consent required for optional phone/demographics. Withdrawal clears respective fields atomically; null clears field. Email change excluded; future change must verify new address.

Session.description: Own sessions only. IP may be IPv4/IPv6, shared/NAT/VPN; not verified location or personal identity.

Tokens.description: Opaque cryptographic tokens; server stores digests. Refresh rotates; every authorized request checks active session. Secure platform storage, never logs.

Member.description: Limited sharing identity, never phone/demographics/IP/device data.

ListInput.description: Client-generated UUID; owner from authentication. No share checkbox. Icon is emoji or legacy key.

ListDeleteResult.description: Atomic pre-deletion counts for detailed deletion toast.

Reminder.description: Non-none requires dueDate. Email/push requires opt-in and configured worker/provider; not implemented by the contract.

TaskInput.description: Only created inside existing list. Defaults: false completed/important; null date/assignee; empty arrays/notes; reminder none/local in user timeZone. UI displays dates dd-MMM-yyyy; wire uses YYYY-MM-DD. Subtasks hidden in current UI.

TaskOrder.description: Entire exact pending or completed partition, atomic reorder; missing/extra/duplicate IDs or stale order revision rejected.

Invitation.description: Pending recipient sees metadata only; never task content/account-existence flag. Accepted -> membership. Ignore/revoke/expiry stop mail reminders.

RequestContext.description: Internal audit on every server request including failures. Server derives actor/IP/result. Only trust proxy headers from allowlisted peers. Never log OTP/tokens/SMTP secret/raw request bodies/query values/task text/phone/demographic values. Log changed field names and consent transition. No public audit API.

Activity.description: Access-filtered user feed, distinct from internal audit; no IP/profile/session values.

ClientEvent.description: Optional consented offline events; untrusted client time/action. IP at upload, not historical action IP. No task/profile contents.

AccessRevoked.description: Purge shared cached list/task/attachments and cancel queued edits. Never contains task contents.

SyncPage.description: No cursor starts consistent paginated snapshot. Cursor binds user/authorization generation/high-water mark, retention 30 days. Exhaust snapshot then deltas. Stable replay within retention. Revocation invalidates authorization-bound cursor ->410 CURSOR_RESET_REQUIRED: discard server-owned cache and refetch snapshot, keep private local-only data separate. Include tombstones/revocations, pending invite metadata only. Commit page+cursor atomically in SQLite.

LocalBackupList.description: Legacy string list IDs; all legacy fields retained. joined/invitees are local drafts, never membership authority.

LocalBackupTask.description: Legacy integer task IDs; unknown fields/hidden subtasks retained for bounded migration.

Backup.description: Format 1 JSON or typed XML. No attachment bytes; filenames only. Server maps UUIDs back to unique legacy-compatible list-string/task-integer IDs, preserving references and order.

ExportJob.description: Consistent authorized snapshot; expires 24h. Access revocation invalidates export, download rechecks rights. No OTP/tokens/IP/phone/demographic profile export.

ImportJob.description: Copy import into new private owned lists; no overwrite/delete existing data or membership activation. Dry run returns proposed ID map/counts with no writes. Atomic commit with exact idempotency replay.

RequestId.name: X-Request-ID
RequestId.description: Optional correlation UUID, validated/generated server-side; returned in X-Request-ID.

DeviceId.name: X-Device-ID
DeviceId.description: Installation UUID must match session when provided; metadata is not authorization.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scope actor or challenge/refresh-family + operation + key. Retain normal successes 24h; changed payload ->409. Replay rechecks authorization and never resurrects revoked access. OTP/refresh credential response replay encrypted and limited to 60s and original valid session context.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted revision from ETag. Atomic authorization/version check/write. Missing 428, stale 412; refetch and reconcile.

bearerAuth.description: Active session bound opaque token. Check revocation on every request.
